combo.description: Surprise your enemy by using E to tunnel then Flash W, AA Q AA E AA.
Use an existing tunnel then Q E W, AA Q AA E AA.
To get to a distant enemy, Q while burrowed then R, followed by AA Q AA E AA.
For a long combo use E to tunnel then Q W, AA Q AA AA E AA then R to finish.
Your basic trade pattern is AA Q AA AA then E to finish.
Your basic full combo is Q W, AA Q AA AA E R.
Utilize your abilites early by using Q in burrowed form then W. AA Q AA AA, then E AA.
